g.text: 7 COMPLEMENT PAIRS / 14 VALID STATES / 3 D4 FAMILIES
At fixed edge slots, swapping all inside/outside labels changes the lookup pairing in these cases.
Orange = input A. Blue = complemented input B. Filled corner = inside; hollow = outside; yellow = face turn.
Complement is not a valid compression symmetry
Both sides are valid inputs, separate from the 174 invalid keys.
